standard.summary: 在训练中混入 caption 变体（同一图像的多种描述方式）的比例。有助于提升 LoRA 对不同描述风格的适应性。
standard.effect: 0.0 = 总是使用主 caption；0.3 = 30% 的步骤从变体 caption 池中随机选一个；1.0 = 总是使用变体。
standard.whenToUse: 每张图有多个 caption 变体时开启（通过 caption_variants 字段指定变体列表）。
standard.avoidWhen: 没有 caption 变体文件时设为 0，否则会 fallback 到主 caption 或产生错误。

standard_en.summary: How often caption variants (several ways of describing the same image) are mixed into training. It helps the LoRA cope with different description styles.
standard_en.effect: 0.0 = always the main caption; 0.3 = 30% of steps draw one at random from the variant pool; 1.0 = always a variant.
standard_en.whenToUse: Turn it on when each image has several caption variants (listed through the caption_variants field).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Set it to 0 when there are no variant files, or it falls back to the main caption or errors out.

advanced.principle: caption 变体通常存储在 .caption_variants.json 等辅助文件中，训练时按比例从主 caption 和变体池随机采样。
advanced.tradeoffs: caption 多样性有助于 LoRA 的语言泛化，但需要额外制作 caption 变体文件（增加数据准备工作量）。

advanced_en.principle: Caption variants are usually stored in auxiliary files such as .caption_variants.json; during training they are sampled by ratio from the main caption and the variant pool.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Caption diversity helps the LoRA's language generalization, but requires producing variant files (extra data-prep work).
